name: SGE Solar - Second Generation Energy
old_description: We know that you have a lot of choices when it comes to who installs your solar system. We are asking for your business because we’re sure that we will exceed your expectations on service, quality, communication. and expertise. In fact, the majority of our customers are referred to us by our happy customers! We are local and were founded right here in Massachusetts, so we know how solar works here!
about: SGE Solar operates from Milford, Massachusetts, providing solar system installation and service. The company emphasizes its local roots in Massachusetts and a referral-driven customer base. Specific founding year, founders, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed in the available sources.
